signer.description: The account whose bundle's `sig1` key signed it.

matches.description: The other items of the owner that share a tag with this one.

exposed.description: The collections the member could open: treat their items as seen.

ip.description: The requester's address, cut to its /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6).

phrase.description: The five words the new device shows; they must match.

custom.description: For `add-member` and `role`: the custom permissions, when the role is `custom`.
